{{Top|leg}}
'''Intelligence Report No: 97-213''' was a report by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] that explained how the government of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] survived the [[Destruction of Taris]] by freezing themselves in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] within the [[Transport Station 5]]. It also included information on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ember Squad]], who were sent to retrieve them.<ref name="The Fathers of Taris">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Fathers of Taris|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
